description: When masked agents began disappearing people off the streets, Scott passed first-in-the-nation legislation to make it illegal for ICE to wear masks, and he is now working to end impunity for ICE by allowing you to sue them when they violate your rights — it’s currently nearly impossible to sue them under federal law. In Congress, Scott will fight to protect our immigrant neighbors and ABOLISH ICE!!!

title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Immigration & Fighting ICE
